episode_row: every Hetzner cron job dead since cutover (dash, no `source`)

commits.subject: feat(cron): add reproducible Hetzner cron setup script
commits.body:
The Hetzner crontab was installed manually and used `source .env`,
but cron's default shell is /bin/sh (dash on Debian) which has no
`source` builtin. Every cron job died on the first line with
"source: not found" before reaching the bts CLI. Result: yesterday's
result-checking, the 2am reconcile, the 3am preview pick generation,
and the 5-min lineup time collector were all silently broken since
the Hetzner cutover on April 11.

This script mirrors the cron-setup-pi5.sh pattern with the correct
POSIX dot-source (`. ./.env`), uses BTS-HETZNER markers for
idempotent install/remove, and documents the dash gotcha at the top.
